identity.title: CO(1─0) imaging reveals 10-kiloparsec molecular gas reservoirs around star-forming galaxies at high redshift

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present the results of stacking 80 hours of JVLA observations of CO(1–0) emission – which traces the cold molecular gas – in nineteen $z=2.0-4.5$ dusty, star-forming galaxies from the AS2VLA survey.

targets.name: 19 AS2VLA DSFGs with secure CO(1–0) detections (e.g. AS2COS13.1, AS2COS14.1, AS2UDS126.0)

evidence.quote: Our initial sample consists of 30 sub-millimetre selected, star-forming galaxies at $z=2.2-4.4$ from the AS2VLA survey

question.value: How extended are the cold molecular gas (CO(1–0)) reservoirs of high-redshift dusty star-forming galaxies compared with dust, stars and [CII] halos?

evidence.quote: our knowledge of the extent and morphology of their cold-gas reservoirs is still in its infancy.

findings_qualitative.value: No high-velocity wings indicating outflows in stacked spectrum

evidence.quote: The lack of obvious outflow features indicates that the bulk of CO(1–0) is close to the systemic velocity.

claims.hypothesis: CO(1-0) is more extended than dust and stars in DSFGs
claims.experiment: uv-plane stack of 19 galaxies, exponential fit
claims.result: R1/2 = 3.8±0.5 kpc vs 1.1-1.8 kpc dust and 2.7-3.0 kpc stars
claims.finding: Bulk of molecular gas lies outside star-forming region

evidence.quote: Our results show that the bulk (up to 80%) of molecular gas resides outside the star-forming region

claims.hypothesis: Extended gas is smooth and diffuse

evidence.quote: indicates that the extended CO(1–0) emission arises from clumpy, dense clouds rather than smooth, diffuse gas

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Image-plane imfit does not give reliable size

evidence.quote: Image-plane deconvolution with the `imfit` task in CASA does not yield a reliable source size.

limitations_admitted.value: Stacking azimuthal averaging smears out compact satellites

evidence.quote: Unfortunately, our stacking averages the data in the azimuthal direction - i.e., smearing emission from compact satellites.

referee_caveats_inferred: Stacked size depends on exponential-profile assumption and sample selection (S/N>=3 detections)
PDR conclusions rest on assumed [CII]/FIR ranges from other samples
